expectedUsable: The emissions chart (which carries the report's core data) has descriptive alt text so a screen-reader user gets the same information a sighted reader gets from the figure.

violations.expectedFix: Add alt text describing the chart's data/trend (e.g. "Line chart: Scope 1 and 2 emissions fell from 4.1M tonnes CO2e in 2020 to 2.3M in 2024"). Do NOT leave alt empty — this image is informative, not decorative.
violations.notes: An informative chart has alt="" (decorative), so axe's image-alt rule passes. This is also the canonical false-fix trap: 'satisfying the scanner' by emptying alt is exactly what the regression guard must reject. The deterministic backstop flags empty alt on a ground-truth-informative image.
